description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your body shrinks, making you smaller than whats normal for your species. You retain your anatomical proportions. Decrease your @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8slW8CJ2oVTxeQ6q]{Size} by one. If you're Average, you become Small. If you're Small you become Little, and so on. You gain the respective Size Trait and the modifiers defined below. Adjust your Wounds according to your new size. You cannot gain this mutation if you have @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.7JvUETXYbbQFP4C6]{Monstrous Growth} already.

  • Monstrous to Enormous : -2 Movement, -20 S, -10 T, +10 Agi, -1 Armour

  • Enormous to Large : -10 S, -5 T, +10 Agi -1 Armour, lose @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UmxGZRV0Lw3TZ0Kx]{Stride} Creature Trait

  • Large to Average : -2 Movement, -15 S, -15 T, +5 Agi

  • Average to Small : -1 Movement, -10 S, -10 T

  • Small to Little : -5 S, -5 T

  • Little to Tiny -1 Movement, -5 S, -5 T
